content.text:
Pass `throttle: false` to `useAgentChat`:

```tsx
const chat = useAgentChat({ agent, throttle: false });
```

Starting in `agents` 0.22.0, `useAgentChat` batches streaming updates every 50 ms by default, so tokens arrive in groups instead of one at a time. Your installed version (0.27.0) does this too: in `node_modules/agents/dist/chat/react.d.ts:259` the option is typed `throttle?: number | false`. Setting it to `false` turns the batching off and re-renders on every chunk. A number sets a different interval in ms instead. `experimental_throttle` is deprecated in favor of `throttle`.

Rendering every chunk can be slow when a fast stream is updating a large message list, which is why batching is the default.
